requirement: Test sends reach only the server list, are ledgered before one Gmail call, and an unanswered send is reconciled, never resent

oracle.invariant: An approved draft sent to a listed address makes exactly one messages.send; the same requestKey returns the first row with no second call; another payload under it answers REAL_REQUEST_KEY_REUSED. Off, an unlisted address, a stale or unapproved draft, a disconnected mailbox and a reached cap are refused before any call. A send with no answer is send_unknown; reconcile with no match keeps it unknown; one match makes it sent; the send count stays one. A row left in sending while the mailbox lock is free becomes send_unknown with no call; two concurrent sends give one REAL_SEND_BUSY. INVITATIONS_SENDING=test reads as off on staging and production and without a list. Review content offers only the server list and posts one send per press with the current draft revision.
